layers.authority: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park administration (reported by the Hunan Provincial Government)
layers.process: After its June 2025 reopening following heavy rain, Zhangjiajie National Forest Park applies routine visitor flow control with a daily limit of 53,000 visitors, and visitors must book tickets in advance. Check weather and official notices before travel.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park reopens
sources.authority: The People's Government of Hunan Province (English site)
sources.supports: 53,000 daily limit and advance reservation (read directly 2026-11-06; article dated June 2025)

zone-requirements.note: The article is from June 2025. The booking channel and any change to the limit were not confirmed on the park's own site. Lead time is not published; 0 is a placeholder.
